headline: Fiskars Shares Surge 7.4% Following Third-Quarter Earnings
summary: Shares of consumer goods group Fiskars gained 7.4% after the company released its third-quarter financial results.
why: Fiskars is a publicly listed Finnish consumer goods company known globally for home, garden, and outdoor brands.

impacts.name: Fiskars Oyj Abp
impacts.why: Third-quarter results surpassed expectations, driving a 7.4% share surge.

why_moved: Fiskars shares rallied 7.4% in response to the company's third-quarter earnings report.
